roles.noKeys: Your wallet has not opened the company on this visit, so who reads its records cannot be read yet.
roles.reading: Reading who reads the company's records.
roles.reads.limited: Reads the signers, the policies and each proposal's summary, never what a proposal pays.
roles.reads.accountant: Reads the people, the payroll runs and what each run pays each person, the signers, the policies and each proposal's summary.
roles.readers.title: Readers
roles.readers.description: A reader holds no seat. They approve, invite and file nothing, and no count of approvals includes them. What each reads is set by the role they were given.
roles.readers.none: No reader has been given read access to the company's records.
roles.reader.takeAway.says: Taking a reader away takes effect once enough signers have signed it. Your wallet then changes the company's key. The reader can still read everything their access covered before that, opened or not. Records sealed after the key changes stay closed to them. If the key could not be changed, your wallet says so. Until it is changed, the reader can still open new records.
roles.give.title: Give read access
roles.give.description: Someone who is not a signer can read the company's records without a seat. They make a code from their own wallet for this company, and you give them access from it. They can read the company's older records of what they read, as well as new ones. The company's service is told their name.
roles.give.code.label: The reader's code
roles.give.code.hint: Ask them to make the code in their wallet for this company and paste all of it here. Your wallet shows who the code is for and a fingerprint of it. Compare it with the one they read out to you, by a call or in person, and not through this page.
roles.give.role.label: What they read
roles.give.bar: Your seat signs the change in your wallet. It comes into force once as many signers as a change of who is seated needs have signed it, each in their own wallet. Until then the access in force stays as it is.
roles.waiting.title: Changes waiting for more signers
roles.waiting.description: A change of who reads comes into force once enough signers have signed it. A change another signer started can be signed from your seat.
roles.waiting.takeAway: Take away the read access of {person}, who reads as {role}.
roles.waiting.many: This waiting change gives or takes away the access of more than one reader, so it cannot be signed from here.
roles.waiting.count: {signed} of the {needed} signers needed have signed it.
roles.waiting.count.unread: How many signers have signed it could not be counted. {needed} are needed.
roles.waiting.notMine: Your seat has not signed it.
roles.waiting.code.label: The reader's code, again
roles.waiting.code.hint: To sign a give, your wallet needs the reader's code again, the text their wallet made. Until you have it you cannot sign: ask the reader, or the signer who started the change, to send it to you.
roles.done.waiting: Your seat has signed. The change waits until {needed} signers have signed it, and {signed} have.
roles.done.unknown: Your seat has signed. How many signers have signed it could not be read.
roles.carries.in-force: Your signature brought the change into force.
roles.carries.signed: The waiting change now carries your seat's signature.
roles.carries.not-the-waiting-change: That is not the waiting change. What your wallet signed is a different change, so the waiting one has not gained your signature. Ask for the code of the reader the waiting change names, and the same role.
roles.carries.unread: Your wallet signed, but the readers could not be read again to check that it counted. Reload the page.
roles.why.seat: Your wallet could not find your seat on this company, so nothing was filed. Open the company with your wallet and try again.
roles.why.not-a-code: What was pasted is not a reader's code, so nothing was filed. Ask the reader for the code their wallet made for this company and paste all of it.
roles.why.code-not-signed: The code was not signed by the wallet it names, so a part of it was changed. Nothing was filed. Ask the reader to make a new code.
roles.why.code-another-company: The code was made for another company, so nothing was filed. Ask the reader to make one for this company.
roles.why.not-as-asked: Your wallet did not know what the page asked for, so nothing was filed. Reload the page and try again.
roles.why.filed-meanwhile: Another signer filed a change at the same moment, so yours was not filed. Try again: your wallet reads what they filed first and signs yours after it.
roles.why.not-filed: Your change was not filed. Read the readers again before you try, because it may have been filed after all.
roles.why.stopped: Your wallet stopped before the change was filed.
roles.why.other: Your wallet stopped for a reason the page does not know. Read the readers again before you try.
roles.sent: The wallet stopped, but before it did it handed over something that may already have been sent. Read the readers again before you try.
roles.partial: Part of the change may already have gone through. Read the readers again before you ask twice.
roles.list.title: Roles
roles.list.description: A signer holds a seat, and a seat keeps the role it was invited at. A reader holds no seat and is given read access instead.
roles.list.foundingSays: The founding seat holds no role of its own and may do what an admin may, so it is listed with the admins.
roles.list.unread: Who holds each role cannot be read until your wallet has opened the company on this visit.
roles.may.hold: Holds a payroll run that has not been charged or paid yet, once, on the vaults the seat is given. Only the seat that placed the hold releases it at once. If that seat is removed or given another role, the hold is released by as many signers as it needed, counted again after each removal.
roles.may.invite: Invites people to a seat and withdraws an invitation.
roles.may.files: Files every kind of company record.
roles.reads.purpose.payroll: The payroll runs and what each run pays each person.
roles.reads.purpose.proposals: Each proposal's summary, never what a proposal pays.
roles.change.title: Change a signer's role
roles.change.description: A seat keeps the role it was invited at, so a role changes in two steps: the seat is removed, and then the person is invited at the new role. Each step is approved as any removal or invitation is. The person is invited again on every vault, so a seat that held only named vaults comes back on all of them.
roles.change.seat.label: The seat
roles.change.role.label: The new role
roles.change.address.label: The person's address
roles.change.address.hint: The full private address from the person's wallet, typed or pasted in full. The invitation goes to this address, so check it with the person.
roles.change.public: A seat leaving and a seat joining are public on the network.
roles.change.forgets: This page keeps what it needs for the second step only until it is reloaded. If it is reloaded between the two steps, wait until the seat has gone and invite the person at the new role with Invite.
roles.change.none: There is no seat to change.
roles.change.problem.no-name: The roster holds no name for this seat, so the change cannot be asked for.
roles.change.problem.bad-address: Type the person's full private address.
roles.change.problem.same-role: The seat already holds that role. Choose another.
roles.change.done.remove: The removal of {name}'s seat is raised. {approvals} of the {needed} approvals it needs are in. Once the network has carried it out, press Continue to invite them as {role}.
roles.change.done.remove.unknown: The removal of {name}'s seat is raised. Once the network has carried it out, press Continue to invite them as {role}.
roles.change.done.invite: {name} is invited as {role}. The company's signers approve the invitation as they approve any.
roles.change.done.unknown: The wallet finished, but did not say which step it was. Read the seats again.
roles.change.why.seat: Your wallet could not find your seat on this company, so nothing was sent. Open the company with your wallet and try again.
roles.change.why.removal-under-way: The removal of this seat is raised and not yet carried out, so the person cannot be invited again yet. Approve it and carry it out from the Proposals page, then press Continue.
roles.change.why.fewer-approvals-first: Once this seat is removed the company would hold fewer signers than its approvals need, so it cannot be removed as a change of role. Remove the signer with Remove a signer, choosing fewer approvals there, then invite them with Invite.
roles.change.why.not-as-started: The address or the role is not the one the removal was raised with. Press again with that address and role; to invite someone else, or as another role, use Invite.
roles.change.why.not-started-here: This wallet did not raise the removal of this seat as a change of role, so it does not know whom to invite or as which role. The signer who raised it presses again in their own wallet, or invite the person with Invite.
roles.change.why.not-an-address: That is not a private address on this network, so nothing was sent. Ask the person for their wallet's address.
roles.change.why.not-as-asked: Your wallet did not take the change as the page asked for it, so nothing was sent. Reload the page and try again.
roles.change.why.stopped: Your wallet stopped before it sent anything.
roles.change.why.other: Your wallet stopped for a reason the page does not know. Read the seats again before you try.
roles.change.sent: The wallet stopped, but before it did it handed over something that may already have been sent. Read the seats again before you try.
roles.change.partial: Part of the change may already have gone through. Read the seats again before you ask twice.
roles.continue.title: Changes begun on this visit
roles.continue.description: These changes have their first step raised. Once the network has carried the removal out, continue to invite the person.
roles.drop.says: Drop forgets a change you began and no longer want, on this wallet. Nothing is sent and nothing changes on the network or in the company's records. A removal that was already raised stays raised.
roles.drop.done.dropped: {name}'s change of role was dropped from this wallet.
roles.drop.done.not-kept: This wallet kept no change of role for {name}, so there was nothing to drop. It is no longer listed here.
roles.drop.done.unknown: The wallet did not say whether the change was dropped. Read the seats again.
roles.leaving.note: A seat that is being removed may be a change of role begun on another device, or before this page was reloaded. This page cannot continue it. Once the seat has gone, invite the person at the new role with Invite.
roles.readerLink.title: The reader's link
roles.readerLink.description: Send this to the person you want to give read access. It opens the page where their wallet makes the code you paste below. It holds no key.
